node: Sulphur and sulphuric-acid feedstock for copper SX-EW and nickel HPAL
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a thin US-listed universe with direct or second-order exposure to the sulphur/sulphuric-acid chokepoint. The cleanest underfollowed lane candidates are Hawkins as a US industrial-chemical distributor that explicitly handles sulfuric acid, and Ardmore Shipping as a small-cap product/chemical tanker operator that could be exposed to rerouted chemical/acid flows. Reference anchors are Freeport-McMoRan and Southern Copper: both are large copper producers tied to SX-EW/leaching and sulfuric-acid integration, but they are included mainly to map demand sensitivity and internal byproduct-acid offsets rather than as obscure alpha candidates. Several more direct acid assets appear private, foreign-listed, or OTC-only, creating a coverage gap for later passes.
